### Q-002 — Syntax highlighting highlighter code colouring dependency?

> _2026-11-25 · realm/blong-agent · answered_

Asked: 2026-11-25 — "syntax highlighting highlighter code colouring dependency"

Asked: 2026-11-25 — "what highlighter library do we use for code blocks"

Asked: 2026-11-25 — "which highlighting library colours the code fences"

Asked: 2026-11-25 — "what highlighter do we use for code blocks"

Answer: Settled: the transcript colours code with `@speed-highlight/core` v2 rather than a scanner
of its own, and `@@D-1011` holds the reasoning — the grammars it brings, the size comparison that
rejected Sugar High and MicroLighter, and the two consequences (a fence tokenized whole and then cut
at its newlines, and the palette split into a light and a dark set). The hits this question was
matched to predate the change: `@@T-799` is the scanner `@@D-1011` replaced, and `@@F-838` is why
the grammars arrive as one registry instead of one subpath per language. Nothing about a
code-colouring dependency is still open to decide.
